fnol_text: My name is Ines Osei and I live at 489 Sycamore Court, Greenville, SC 29646. You can reach me on (555) 796-8052 or ines.osei@example.com. On 20 September 2026 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Fatima Zielinski, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00034. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Osei on (555) 796-8052 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 20 September 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Ingrid Vasquez gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Fatima Zielinski reports a mild concussion and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Ines reports a mild concussion.
